bath: Fill the tub with warm water (37–39°C — not too hot)
Add 2 cups Epsom salt + a few drops of lavender essential oil
Optional: add a tablespoon of coconut oil for extra skin softness
Soak for 15–20 min — let muscles fully relax
Pat dry gently, then apply body lotion while skin is still slightly damp
claywrap: Mix kaolin or bentonite clay with warm water to a smooth paste
Apply a generous, even layer over body — avoid face and neck
Wrap loosely in cling film or a warm towel to lock in heat
Leave on for 20–25 min while you rest
Rinse off in the shower, then pat dry and moisturise well
scrub: Wet your skin in the shower with warm water
Take a generous amount of coffee or sugar scrub in your hands
Massage in circular motions starting from feet, moving upward
Pay extra attention to knees, elbows, and heels
Rinse thoroughly, then apply body oil or moisturiser immediately
roseoil: Warm a few drops of rose hip oil between your palms
Start at shoulders — use long, sweeping strokes down the arms
Work on the stomach in slow clockwise circles
Massage legs from ankle to thigh with firm upward pressure
Finish by gently pressing palms over your décolletage for 30s
facesteam: Boil water and pour into a bowl — add chamomile or rosemary if you have it
Cleanse your face thoroughly before steaming
Drape a towel over your head and lean over the bowl
Keep face 20–30 cm from the water — steam for 8–10 min
Pat dry, apply a toner, then follow with your serum and moisturiser
coldplunge: Start with a warm shower to open pores and relax muscles
Gradually turn the temperature to cold over 30–60 seconds
Focus on steady breathing — inhale deeply, exhale slowly
Stay under cold water for 2–3 min (build up to 5 min over time)
Finish, towel off quickly, and do light movement to rewarm
greenteamask: Mix 1 tbsp matcha or green tea powder with plain yoghurt or honey
Cleanse skin, then apply mask evenly to face and neck
Optionally apply a thin layer to arms or chest as an antioxidant boost
Leave on for 15–20 min — relax and avoid talking
Rinse with lukewarm water, follow with toner and moisturiser
meditation: Find a quiet spot — sit or lie down comfortably
Close your eyes and take 5 deep breaths: 4 sec in, 4 sec out
Body scan: mentally relax each body part from toes to crown
Focus on your breath — when thoughts come, gently return to breathing
End with 3 gratitude thoughts, then slowly open your eyes

privacy.section2Intro: We collect the following types of personal data when you use MomManager:
section2Items: Account data: email address, name, profile photo (if provided)
App data: tasks, children's information, meal plans, budget entries, and other content you create within the App — stored locally on your device or in your personal cloud storage
Usage data: app interactions, feature usage, and crash reports for improving the App
Payment data: subscription status (processed by Apple/Google — we do not store payment card details)

section3Items: Provide and maintain the MomManager service
Improve the App through anonymised analytics

We do not store AI conversations on our servers. Please do not share sensitive personal information such as passwords, financial account numbers, or medical records in AI chat.

privacy.section6Body: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we will delete your personal data within 30 days, except where we are required to retain it by law.
privacy.section7Intro: Under UK GDPR and applicable data protection law, you have the right to:
section7Items: Access the personal data we hold about you
Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
Object to or restrict processing of your data
Lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk
privacy.section7Contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at support@mommanager.co.uk.
privacy.section8Body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no internet transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.section9Body: MomManager is intended for use by adults (18+). We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us so we can delete it.
privacy.section10Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via the App or by email. The latest version will always be available within the App.
privacy.section11Body: For any privacy-related questions or requests, contact us at support@mommanager.co.uk or write to SoldOut Digital LTD, United Kingdom.
